protocol.scope: Time-stepped actuator-to-response simulation, without body attitude, rigid-body integration, PID, flight controller, scheduler or hardware integration
protocol.tick_order: Advance plant with prior commands; generate/deliver causal RPM packets; record actual response; controller consumes request and RPM metadata only; emit commands for the following interval
protocol.plant_controller_separation: Plant direction, counts, RPM derivative, response map and actual response are never fed to the coordinator after initial corrected-count reset. RPM packets are the only simulated measurement input.
protocol.reaction_scope: The existing scalar Q+Jalpha model is an explicitly synthetic additive yaw disturbance, independent of virtual tail direction. B contains none of that full reaction term. No tilted-axis rotor or gyroscopic physics is claimed.

telemetry.timestamp_semantics: Decoder capture timestamp is retained through a delayed software queue; observer age includes software delivery delay. This is not an ESC-internal measurement-time claim.

protocol.provenance: All maps, coefficients, servo parameters, rotor/motor dynamics and counts-to-direction mappings are arbitrary synthetic placeholders. No CAD/CG/inertia inputs are required by the controller; no aircraft parameters or mechanical angles are calibrated. These deterministic counterfactual simulations cannot establish flight stability or real-aircraft torque/response accuracy.

comparisons.interpretation: Descriptive synthetic errors only; no assertion that compensation improves every axis or scenario
